description: This file defines the 'LegacyGrainId' class, which is a core component in the Orleans framework for representing grain identifiers in a legacy format. It includes methods for creating, parsing, and converting grain IDs, as well as internal caching mechanisms and string representations.

classes.name: LegacyGrainId
classes.description: A sealed class representing a legacy grain identifier in the Orleans framework, providing methods for creation, conversion, parsing, and string representation of grain IDs.

methods.name: NewId
methods.description: Creates a new unique LegacyGrainId for a grain.

methods.name: GetGrainId
methods.description: Retrieves a LegacyGrainId based on a provided UniqueKey.

methods.name: GetSystemTargetGrainId
methods.description: Retrieves a system target grain ID based on type data.

methods.name: GetGrainType
methods.description: Constructs a GrainType object based on type code and key extension flag.

methods.name: CreateGrainType
methods.description: Creates a byte array representing a grain type from prefix bytes and type code.

methods.name: ToGrainId
methods.description: Converts this LegacyGrainId to a GrainId object.

methods.name: TryConvertFromGrainId
methods.description: Attempts to convert a GrainId to a LegacyGrainId, returning success status.

methods.name: FromGrainId
methods.description: Converts a GrainId to a LegacyGrainId, throwing if conversion is not possible.

methods.name: FromGrainIdInternal
methods.description: Internal method to parse a GrainId into a LegacyGrainId if possible.

methods.name: FromParsableString
methods.description: Creates a LegacyGrainId from a string in the standard format.

methods.name: GetHashCode_Modulo
methods.description: Computes a hash code modulo a given value.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this LegacyGrainId with another for ordering.
